description: Five records taken from the TAIL of the fixture - rows 46 through 50 one-based, addressed as fromRow 45 zero-based plus rowCount 5 - to prove POSITIONAL INDEPENDENCE. app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl has no first-record case and no last-record case: :74-81 is a single PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' guarded once, :93 is a bare READ that positions by nothing, and :78 displays whatever that READ delivered. Nothing in the program counts records, compares a key against the previous one, or treats either end of the file differently, so a five-record window from the end must behave exactly as a five-record window from the beginning does - and that is the assertion here. Where case06 reads three rows from the head and case01 reads all fifty, this case reads five from the tail and must produce the same shape. Because the window ENDS on the fixture's highest key, 9805583408996588, it also exercises the top of the key range inside a MULTI-RECORD run, which complements case04: there the final row is pinned in isolation, so it is simultaneously the first and the last record and a translation that special-cased either end could still pass. Here it cannot, because four records precede it. WHAT THE CLASS NAME GETS WRONG: the unit under test is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - an Account-named class in the account package - yet CBACT02C computes no balance and never touches the account file. It reads the CARD file. :29-33 is SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO CARDFILE, ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, RECORD KEY IS FD-CARD-NUM; :37-40 is an FD of FD-CARD-NUM X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA X(134) = 150; and :45 is COPY CVACT02Y. AAP rule R1 governs - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and the divergence is catalogued in the register at AAP 0.8.4, so a reviewer who trusts the class name will look for the wrong file and the wrong arithmetic. THE RUN, once through :70-87. :71 displays the 38-character start banner. :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, whose OPEN INPUT at :120 reports '00', so :121 takes its first arm and :126-127 CONTINUE. The loop then runs FIVE full iterations: each READ at :93 lands on the CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' arm at :94, and :78 displays CARD-RECORD - the 01 group item, so the whole 150-byte area including its FILLER. :96 is a COMMENT and there is no display paragraph anywhere in the program, so one record yields exactly ONE line and no separator, header, page break or blank line is emitted between images. The sixth READ reports '10', :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :107 finds the 88-level APPL-EOF true and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE, so the loop ends without a sixth display. 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE reports '00' at :139, :140 SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT leaves zero, :85 displays the 36-character end banner, and GOBACK at :87 leaves RETURN-CODE 0. In repository terms the status sequence is: startBrowse '00', then readNext '00' five times, then readNext '10', then endBrowse '00' (gate G47). The job is driven at tasklet/step level, with no JobLauncher and no HTTP anywhere in the path (gate G51). MESSAGE ARITHMETIC: 1 start banner + 5 record images + 1 end banner = 7 ordered DISPLAY_LINE entries, of widths 38, 150, 150, 150, 150, 150 and 36. RECORD GEOMETRY, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy (01 CARD-RECORD, RECLN 150), one-based offsets: CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at 1-16, and also the RECORD KEY; CARD-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at 17-27; CARD-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) at 28-30; CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME PIC X(50) at 31-80; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10) at 81-90; CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS PIC X(01) at 91; FILLER PIC X(59) at 92-150. 16+11+3+50+10+1+59 = 150, so every image below ends in 59 spaces, and those spaces are significant and must not be trimmed (gates G19 and G21). THE MISSPELLING IS THE CONTRACT: the copybook spells the date field CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE, missing the second T, exactly as CVACT01Y spells its own ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE; it is written verbatim and never silently corrected to CARD-EXPIRATION-DATE, because field-for-field diffing keys on the name (AAP implicit requirement I1). CVACT02Y declares no COMP-3, no PACKED-DECIMAL and no S9, so both numeric spans - CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) and CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) - are UNSIGNED zoned DISPLAY: there is no sign overpunch byte to model in this record and no span of it may be decoded as though there were. THE FIVE ROWS, DECOMPOSED at those offsets - read from app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt rather than invented, and kept in file order, which a KSDS browse of :31's SEQUENTIAL access delivers as ascending RECORD KEY order. Row 1 - fixture row 46 - CARD-NUM 9056297931664011, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000025, CARD-CVV-CD 931, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Elliott Howell' followed by 36 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2025-07-10, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 2 - fixture row 47 - CARD-NUM 9349107475869214, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000017, CARD-CVV-CD 218, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Sigrid Mann' followed by 39 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2025-03-01, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 3 - fixture row 48 - CARD-NUM 9501733721429893, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000009, CARD-CVV-CD 725, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Melvin Ondricka' followed by 35 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2024-12-27, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 4 - fixture row 49 - CARD-NUM 9680294154603697, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000001, CARD-CVV-CD 045, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Immanuel Kessler' followed by 34 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2025-05-20, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 5 - fixture row 50 - CARD-NUM 9805583408996588, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000040, CARD-CVV-CD 908, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Davon Emmerich' followed by 36 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2023-10-27, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. 9056297931664011 < 9349107475869214 < 9501733721429893 < 9680294154603697 < 9805583408996588, so the displayed order is the browse order, and the five expected images are byte-identical to those five fixture rows. Note CARD-CVV-CD 045 on row 4: it is carried as the three characters 0, 4, 5 and never as the integer 45, which is the standing proof that a PIC 9(n) span is emitted zero-filled to its declared width rather than as a number that has lost its leading zeros; CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000001 on the same row makes the point across eleven characters. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty, and that emptiness is a positive assertion rather than an absence of interest - :120 opens the file INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE at all, its only output being SYSOUT at app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:27. No normalisation is declared, because carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes CVACT02Y declares, so neither recorded fixture-to-copybook deviation applies here. WIRING: app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:22 is a bare //STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C with no PARM, and CBACT02C has no LINKAGE SECTION to receive one into, so jobParameters is empty; its single //CARDFILE DD at :25-26 is the only dataset, addressed here solely by the CARDFILE binding key that application.yml resolves at record length 150, so no dataset-name literal appears anywhere in this file (gate G46). ENCODING is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. PROVENANCE: every expected value in this file is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy for each offset and width, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl for the step and DD contract, and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt for the five seeded rows. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from a live COBOL execution. AAP 0.7.6 proves such a run impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, subprogram linkage that cannot be made executable, a copybook that will not parse, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator alongside three absent IBM copybooks, EBCDIC fixtures needing binary handling, and no alternative compiler installable - and the substitution of provenance is recorded as risk R-A. Only the provenance changes; the 20 cases, the field-for-field diff and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand. GATES PINNED HERE: G15 (one of the twenty cases for this program), G18 (its diff count must be zero), G19 and G21 (the 150-byte width and the space-filled FILLER), G46 (binding key, never a DSNAME), G47 (the file-status sequence above) and G51 (asserted below the HTTP and JobLauncher layers). Not applicable: G30 and G32, since CBACT02C contains no GO TO; G33, since it declares no OCCURS; G16 and both right-pad normalisations, since carddata.txt needs neither; and G20, G24 through G28, G35 and G37 through G43, since this program writes no record, performs no arithmetic beyond its own status bookkeeping, raises no abend on this path and drives no screen. Five records in from the tail, seven lines out, RETURN-CODE 0.
